verses.text: Ix yil-lan sb'a winhaj Adán yet' ix Eva, ix och ix yab'ixal. Ix alji jun yune' ix, ix yak'an ix skuch Caín. Haxo ix yalan ix: Toxo ix ja jun in winak unin yujto a Jehová ix och wet'ok, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix aljipax winhaj Abel yuk'tak winhaj Caín. Ha winhaj Abel chi', moloj kalnel ix sk'ulej winh, haxo pax winhaj Caín chi', ix munlaj winh t'a sat lum lum.
Ix ek' junok tiempo'al, ay jun k'u ix yik'b'at silab' winhaj Caín t'a Jehová, haton tas ix yik' winh t'a smunlajel.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at silab' winhaj Abel chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, haton nok' b'ab'el yune' kalnel, nok' te b'ak'ech. Ix stzalaj Jehová yet' winh yet' silab' ix yak' chi'.
Palta maj tzalajlaj Jehová yet' winhaj Caín yet' pax silab'. Yuj chi', ix te chichon sk'ol winh, te ow ix aj sat winh.
Haxo ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ste chichon a k'o'ol, te owxonhej a sat?

Tato wach' tza k'ulej, tzalajk'olal am ayach ek'i, palta to chuk ix a k'ulej, yuj chi' a a chukal chi', ayxonhejoch t'a ib'anh yik tzach em t'a chukal yuj, palta tzato yal skan chukal chi' t'a yalanh u'uj, xchi Dios.
Ay jun k'u, a winhaj Caín ix awtan winhaj Abel yik sb'at heb' b'eyelek'. Ayik ayek' heb' b'aj ix k'och chi', ix b'at juknaj winhaj Caín t'a winh yuk'tak chi', ix smak'anchamok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'a winhaj Caín chi': --¿B'ajtil ay winh uk'tak aj Abel? xchi t'a winh. Haxo ix tak'wi winh: --Manh wojtakoklaj. ¿Tom yilumal winh waji? xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix a k'ulej? Ha schik'il winh uk'tak ix em t'a sat lum tik u'uj, ichato syal sb'a t'ayin to tzin b'o yaj het'ok.
Ha tikne'ik, katab'il hachxo, swik'kanel opisio t'a sat lum lum tik, haton lum ix uk'anem schik'il winh uk'tak ix a mak'cham chi'.
Ayik ol ach munlaj t'a sat lu'um, malaj jab'ok tas ol ik'a', tonhej ol ixtej a b'a, tonhej ol ach komon b'eyek' t'a sat lu'um, xchi Dios t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Te niwan jun yahelal skotkan tik t'a wib'anh, manh ol techajlaj wu'uj.
Ina ix ik'el wopisio t'a sat lum tik, ix in ik'anel t'a ichanh t'a junelnhej, toxonhej ol in komon b'eyek'ok. Yalxonhej mach ol in chalaj in b'a yet'ok, ol in smak'chamok, xchi winh t'a Dios.

Haxo ix tak'wi Jehová: --Ma'ay. Tato ay junok mach ol ach mak'anchamok, a jun chi', ukel ol ek' spak t'ay, xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch Jehová jun yechel winhaj Caín chi', yik wach' tato ay mach schalaj sb'a winh yet'ok, max mak'jicham winh yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el winhaj Caín b'aj ix lolon heb' chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a jun lugar skuch Nod, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Edén.
Ix yil-lan sb'a winhaj Caín yet' ix yetb'eyum, ix och ix yab'ixal. Ix alji jun yune' ix, Enoc ix sb'iej. Ix sb'o'an jun chonhab' winhaj Caín chi', haxo sb'i yuninal winh chi' ix yak'och sb'iok.
Ha winhaj Enoc smam winhaj Irad. Haxo winhaj Irad smam winhaj Mehujael, haxo winhaj Mehujael smam winhaj Metusael, haxo winhaj Metusael smam winhaj Lamec.
Ha winhaj Lamec chi', chawanh ix aj yetb'eyum winh. Ay jun ix skuch Ada, haxo junxo ix skuch Zila.
Ha ix Ada chi', ix alji jun swinak unin ix, Jabal ix sb'iej. Haton winh ix b'ab'laj b'eyek' yet' spat mantiado yik smolan nok' snok'.
Ha winhaj Jabal chi', ay jun yuk'tak winh skuchan Jubal. Ha winh ix b'ab'laj ak'an te' arpa yet' spu'an flauta.

Haxo ix Zila chi', ix aljipax jun yune' ix, winak unin, Tubal-kaín ix sb'iej. B'o'um k'e'en ix aj winh. Ay tas ix sb'o winh t'a k'e'en bronce yet' t'a k'e'en hierro. Ay jun ix yanab' winh skuchan Naama.
Ay junel ix yal winhaj Lamec t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum icha tik: Ex wetb'eyum, ach Ada yet' ach Zila, ab'ek tas ol wala': Ix in mak'cham jun winh kelem, yujto in lajwi smak'an winh.
Tato ukel spaktzitaj yik winhaj Caín, ok in xom a in tik, 77-el ol paktzitaj t'a heb' tzin tzuntzani, xchi winh.

Haxo winhaj Adán ix alji junxo yuninal winh yet' ix Eva. Set ix sb'iej yuj ix snun chi'. Ix yalan ix icha tik: Ha Dios ix ak'an junxo wune' tik sk'exulok winhaj Abel mak'b'ilcham yuj winhaj Caín, xchi ix.
Haxo winhaj Set chi', ix alji jun yuninal winh, Enós ix yak' winh sb'iok. Atax t'a jun pekti' chi', ix schael yich yalan sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová.
